The implementation now passes all tests and the docstring has been updated to reflect the averaging behavior for even-count medians. However, this introduces test-specific logic: the special case `if p == 50 and n % 2 == 0:` exists solely to satisfy the `test_median_response_time()` test and contradicts the nearest-rank method documented in the README.

The README states "Percentiles use the nearest-rank method so every reported value is a real sample," but the new implementation averages the two middle values for even-count medians (p=50). While the teammate indicated the tests encode the agreed spec, the README should be updated to reflect this API change, or the team should explicitly acknowledge this is an intentional spec change. This will prevent future confusion about the actual behavior vs. documented behavior.
